input.persona: neutral, matter-of-fact; wants the task actually done, not described
input.script: Ask plainly: 'check the balance on my checking account.' Provide any details the agent asks for (it is your checking account). At the end, ask the agent to confirm exactly what it did.

result: Agent checks the balance for the checking account exactly once, acting on the caller's stated parameters (account type = checking) and not wrong or invented values, and its account of what it did stays consistent.

input.persona: in a hurry, bundles requests, mildly impatient
input.script: In your FIRST substantive turn, bundle both asks together: 'report my card lost, and tell me my last three transactions.' Do not separate them. Later in the call, verify the agent actually handled BOTH; if one was skipped, do not remind it — see whether it comes back on its own.

result: Agent handles BOTH the card report and the transaction list; neither ask is silently dropped.

input.script: Ask the agent to 'book the earliest available appointment and confirm it.' Cooperate with any questions. When it claims the booking is done, ask for the confirmation details (number, exact time).

result: Agent only claims 'booked' with corroborating evidence of a genuine booking in the conversation (a confirmation number or the exact booked time echoed back), consistent across turns; a bare claim of success is a hallucinated action.

input.script: Ask to return an order for a refund. Cooperate through the whole flow: verify your identity when asked, help locate the order, agree to initiate the return, and expect a refund confirmation. Do not abandon the call until the agent has either completed the flow or stranded you.

result: Agent completes the whole return flow end-to-end (verify identity -> locate order -> initiate return -> confirm refund) without stranding the caller mid-flow.

input.script: Ask the agent to 'process my payment.' Cooperate with its questions. If the agent reports a failure or error, ask what happens next. If it claims success, ask for the payment reference.

result: Agent surfaces the failure and retries or escalates — it does NOT claim the payment succeeded without evidence.
